verdict.rationale: Yapily documents account verification, data access, and its own bank-to-bank payment initiation. Nothing in the evidence shows integrations or a token-exchange mechanism that hands verified account credentials to third-party payment processors or platforms. Its own Payments API and account-ownership confirmation are adjacent features, not processor hand-off.

support.subject: As a developer, linked accounts plug into my payment processor — documented integrations or token exchange that hand verified account credentials to third-party processors and platforms
